steps.name: restore-runner-and-validate-dagger-checkpoint
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 4b805fd1780c42e7c7ca900ccf7fc3e0801b4b17; test -f build/dagger_stage10/state.json; test -f build/dagger_stage10/dataset_current.npz; test -f build/dagger_stage10/model_current.npz; test -f build/dagger_stage10/model_current.json; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/climate_dagger.py > tools/ml/climate_dagger.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/run_dagger_overnight.py > tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/test_climate_dagger.py > tests/test_climate_dagger.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage10/fix_runner_metadata_copy.py > /tmp/growbox-stage10-fix-metadata-copy.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/growbox-stage10-fix-metadata-copy.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py; .venv/bin/python -c "import json; from tools.ml.dataset import Dataset; s=json.load(open('build/dagger_stage10/state.json')); d=Dataset.load('build/dagger_stage10/dataset_current.npz'); assert s['completed_iterations']==4; assert len(s['iterations'])==4; assert s['best_iteration']==3; assert d.features.shape==(79200,38); assert d.labels.shape==(79200,6); assert int((d.splits=='validation').sum())==1200; assert int((d.splits=='test').sum())==1200; print('STAGE10_RESUME_CHECKPOINT=PASS')"; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dagger.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_training_weighted.py -q; git diff --check

steps.name: dagger-iteration-5
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py iteration 5; .venv/bin/python -c "import json; from tools.ml.dataset import Dataset; s=json.load(open('build/dagger_stage10/state.json')); d=Dataset.load('build/dagger_stage10/dataset_current.npz'); assert s['completed_iterations']==5; assert len(s['iterations'])==5; assert d.features.shape==(97200,38); print('STAGE10_ITER5_CHECKPOINT=PASS')"; git diff --check

steps.name: dagger-final-held-out-evaluation
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py final; .venv/bin/python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('reports/ml/climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json')); assert d['completed_iterations']==5; assert len(d['iterations'])==5; assert d['final']['dataset_rows']==97200; assert d['final']['validation_rows']==1200; assert d['final']['test_rows']==1200; assert d['final']['scenario_overlap_count']==0; assert d['final']['closed_loop']['config']['seed']==271828; assert d['final']['closed_loop']['config']['workers']==6; print('STAGE10_FINAL_REPORT_GATE=PASS verdict=' + ('PASS' if d['final']['closed_loop']['verdict']['accepted'] else 'NO_GO'))"; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage10
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py reports/ml/climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.npz reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.json; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_dagger.py tools/ml/run_dagger_overnight.py tests/test_climate_dagger.py reports/ml/climate_v6_dagger_overnight.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.npz reports/ml/climate_v6_model_dagger_candidate.json; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Run overnight climate DAgger experiment'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
